historical_authority.metadata_note: The 174 Expansion owner words are coverage metadata. This audit compiles the historical representative high-transfer approvals into 93 explicit learner-value surface/family groups; owner existence alone is never an Expansion PASS.

bulk_readback.parser_note: R20 forced two generic readback fixes before acceptance: phrase particles/prepositions must remain visible to construction matching, and morphology/function-word normalization must not erase high-value surfaces such as sort out, take steps, starved of/for, signal that, or so do I. These changes alter retrieval triage only and perform no semantic mutation.

review_model: dual-track: migration fidelity + latest semantic target under current LEARNING_CONTRACT; historical authority is evidence, not immutable truth

core.rule: all other historical R20 Core targets are defective or require a latest-target upgrade at current evidence

severe_examples.word:shoot: Current still gives plant-growth material learner prominence instead of centering fire/project quickly plus film/photo use.
severe_examples.word:short: Current still fragments the high-frequency insufficient-length/time/amount/brief model and retains finance as an ordinary competing branch; the construction family is incomplete.
severe_examples.word:sick: Current still treats the sick as an ordinary noun-like learner sense and lacks the named be sick of / call in sick surfaces.
severe_examples.word:slave: Current figurative treatment needs controlled register/usage rather than neutral coequal Core presentation.
severe_examples.word:smart: Current needs a modern organized model covering intelligent/effective, stylish/neat, and tech-enabled uses while keeping pain/smarting lower.
severe_examples.word:so: Current needs a function-word model for degree/result/pro-form/discourse uses and the major so...that / so that / so do I / if so / so far constructions.
severe_examples.word:socialism: Current definition is too narrow if it equates socialism with universal state ownership; learner target must remain politically neutral and broad enough for major variants.
severe_examples.word:spokesman: Male-specific identity is not sufficiently separated from the neutral spokesperson alternative.
severe_examples.word:sportsman: Male-specific sports-person identity needs neutral athlete/sportsperson guidance where gender is irrelevant.
severe_examples.word:statesman: Male-specific respected-political-leader identity must not be presented as a neutral synonym for politician.
severe_examples.word:speciality: Current has only speciality and no first-class specialty regional spelling/form identity.
severe_examples.word:species: Invariant singular/plural behavior is not first-class learner form metadata.
severe_examples.word:sound: Current still overpromotes nautical strait/depth-measuring branches relative to auditory and valid/healthy uses.

fresh_semantic_judgments.latest: Current already has one clean rough-push learner sense; do not re-split by transitivity.
Current display/evidence/appear/guide plus noun-show organization is learner-usable; keep Core and repair only missing construction family surfaces.
Current single acquired-by-training ability model already matches the desired learner Core.
Current shape/math/fair-settled organization is adequate; square with/up belongs to construction repair rather than Core inflation.
Current rod vs insert/attach/remain/persist Core is sound; the major stick phrasal family remains Expansion debt.
Organize short around insufficient length/time/amount and brief duration; keep finance lower/domain-marked and surface fall/run short, short of, in short and be short for structurally.
Ill/nauseated is Core; the sick is collective adjective use, while be sick of and call in sick are high-value constructions rather than new dictionary senses.
Center the historical/legal condition of enslavement with controlled wording; figurative slave to/away uses require register marking and must not be a neutral coequal Core.
Modern learner Core should support intelligent/effective, stylish/neat, and technology-enabled smart uses; pain/smarting stays lower and the old brisk sense is not foregrounded.

Treat so as a function-word network across degree, manner/reference, result and pro-form/discourse uses; explicitly own so...that, so that, so do I, if so and so far instead of POS-driven micro-senses.
Use a politically neutral broad definition for traditions favoring social/collective/public ownership or control of productive resources; do not equate all forms with universal state ownership.

Preserve their male-specific identities and provide neutral spokesperson / sportsperson or athlete alternatives where gender is irrelevant; statesman remains a marked respected-political-leader term rather than a neutral politician synonym.
Own the pair as a regional spelling/form identity, not as a semantic Relation; Current has speciality only and needs explicit specialty access/identity.
Teach species as an invariant singular/plural form with number supplied by context; keep this in Word/Form identity rather than inventing another lexical sense.
Separate sometime = at an unspecified time, sometimes = on some occasions, and some time = an amount/period of time as a Word/Form/phrase boundary; a two-word relation alone is insufficient.

Keep auditory noun/verb plus sound = valid/healthy as productive learner branches; nautical strait/depth-measuring senses stay technical-lower, with sound like/as if and sound advice surfaced structurally.
